description: Read up to 10 web pages as clean Markdown in one call: each URL returns LLM-ready Markdown with hidden text and prompt injections removed, plus a verdict and robots.txt decision. Honours robots.txt. All-or-nothing: if any URL fails (robots disallow, blocked host, fetch error) the call returns 424 with per-URL errors and nothing is charged. Paid x402 $0.002 USDC per URL on Base (e.g. 5 URLs = $0.010).

mode.description: strip removes injected blocks (default); flag keeps and lists them

name: saferead_read_batch
